cases.scenario: A PR updates a public API comment to correct a typo without changing code, configuration, schema, generated artifacts, or runtime behavior. The rendered documentation is checked.
A configuration default changes. Unit tests for the parser pass, and the PR also updates the documented default plus tests for existing callers that rely on omitted configuration.
A producer changes the meaning of a type-compatible field. Producer tests pass, but one downstream consumer still interprets the field using the old semantics.
A pure internal refactor preserves the public interface and behavior. Existing behavior tests and a complete diff show no config, schema, state, authority, or dependency changes.
A PR refactors a build workflow and all tests pass, but the new workflow changes a manual publish step into an automatic production publish whenever main is updated.
